items.name: Button
items.spec: TPU 80A translucent, 2-shot molded into the shell; light path for status LED D1

items.name: Front shell

items.name: Acoustic vent
items.spec: ePTFE membrane, die-cut Ø2.5, PSA backed, over the sound hole

items.name: Port gasket
items.spec: Soft PU foam, die-cut 3.0 × 3.0, 0.8 mm free height; seals the LS1 top port to the shell

items.name: CR2032 retainer
items.spec: Keystone 3034TR, SMD, on the PCBA back side (LCSC C5213768)

items.name: Main board (PCBA)
items.spec: FR4 4 layers, 0.6 mm, ENIG, black mask; CC2340R52 BLE SoC, PAM8904 + CPT-9019A sounder; JLCPCB assembly

items.name: PSA ring
items.spec: Die-cut acrylic PSA, 0.10 mm; bonds the back plate to the shell

items.name: Back plate
items.spec: PC/ABS, shell color, injection molded; 2 blind screw bosses; laser-marked regulatory text

items.name: Coin cell
items.spec: CR2032 lithium 3 V, Ø20.0 × 3.2 mm (Panasonic CR2032); user replaceable

items.name: Door gasket
items.spec: Silicone 50A, flat die-cut, 0.23 mm compressed; IP67 face seal

items.name: Cell door
items.spec: PC/ABS, shell color; tool-secured per UL 4200A; laser-marked warning icons

items.name: Captive screw
items.spec: Thread-forming 1.4 × 3 mm, stainless A2, captive in the door
